recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the historical extension into core source; if the retired/deprecated Extension Pack artifact or its replacement needs correction, resolve FHIR-57235 or another final FHIR-extensions decision in the Extension Pack repository.
issue_request: FHIR-17276 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3, asking for an equivalent of codesystem-deprecated that could mark a ValueSet.compose concept as discouraged/deprecated without treating that status as an inherent code-system property.
initial_application: Commit 1a0f2e6a2e6dc13ecd149d4bbed9288c1a9441dd applied the issue with message "GF#17276 = valueset deprecated extension" and svn build@14034, matching the Jira comment. The patch added a deprecated boolean extension row scoped to ValueSet.compose.include.concept in source/valueset/valueset-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Current core still builds ValueSet, but source/valueset/implementationguide-ValueSet-core.xml has no extension resources and current source has no valueset-deprecated StructureDefinition beyond the historical OID reservation. The FHIR Extension Pack contains StructureDefinition-valueset-deprecated with the requested URL, boolean value, and ValueSet.compose.include.concept context, while marking it retired/deprecated with a replacement note. FHIR-57235 is a later Submitted FHIR-extensions issue questioning whether that replacement can cover ValueSet.compose.include.concept.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The remaining editable artifact for the historical extension is outside this FHIR core checkout and outside the local core combined branch publish target.

related_jiras.note: The same Zulip discussion split a separate abstract-in-compose request; Jira resolved it No Change through FHIR-16814, so it was not part of this deprecated/discouraged concept extension decision.
Submitted FHIR-extensions issue questioning whether the deprecated valueset-deprecated replacement supports ValueSet.compose.include.concept; unresolved and external to this core reconciliation.
